svg.text: GHOSTED: ATS-9000 model sheet v2, direction B 'Mailbox Bot' + neck (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Upright, neutral turnaround. Body map v2 landmarks. Hand-drawn Bezier profiles extruded / turned; palette rows only. The stamp arm and antenna sit on opposite sides by design.
18 #8E9BA8 body, head, neck core, slot lip, hub, stamp block
22 #2B1E16 ink: outline, screen, slot, neck bellows, treads, rubber
12 #FFE8A6 cream: eyes, scan line (13.3:1 on ink)
21 #B23A26 red-ink: TEXT ONLY, 'NOT A FIT' on the CV (chair call 2)
Shade: base x 0.85 (neutral grey multiplier). No other colour.
- Mailbox Bot: monitor head on an accordion neck,
on a mailbox-arch body, on ink treads; 1.25 m.
- Face = the screen: 2 cream pill eyes + a cream
scan line on ink. Head grown to 176 x 90 u.
- Mouth = the CV slot on the body front, with a
lip tray. It may read as a grin (Rega: fine).
- NECK: bellows, 3 ink rings on a grey core, 50 u.
Head only 68 u deep, so it shows from pitch 42.
- Stamp arm on the robot's LEFT (one hinge), rest
45 deg; antenna on the RIGHT top corner.
- Front: screen + slot. Back: vents + hatch.
- Joins: neck (fixed; rings may bob), antenna
MOTION PARTS (pose panels; joins in blue)
SCAN: the line sweeps the screen top to bottom, eyes go flat (reading)
screen = one decal / UV on the head front; the line scrolls in V
STAMP: rest 45 deg, wind-up 140, slam 0 onto the CV ('NOT A FIT')
SLOT: a CV slides into the slot; the screen starts reading
pose view: yaw 25, pitch 24 (to see the sheet on the lip)
hubs spin + belt scrolls; ball blinks
SCREEN STATES (variants; the body never changes; never angry)
eyes low and soft: sorry, NOT A FIT
Voice line beat: 'KEYWORD SYNERGY NOT FOUND' = loading -> notfit (soft, sorry eyes), then the stamp. Never angry eyes.
64 px SILHOUETTE (front, 3/4, game camera; 1x and x3)
LINEUP AT THE GAME CAMERA (x2): ATS estimate on real Ricky v1 grass with Kit, Ricky, 3 Ghosties. Colour, then greyscale (Lena's formula).
